page.overview:
What is Oxenfurt Academy?

Oxenfurt Academy is a renowned higher education facility located in the Redanian city of Oxenfurt. Founded by Nicodemus de Boot, its main academic rival is the Imperial Academy in Nilfgaard.

One of the academy's more notable achievements was the renovated elven aqueduct, which served as an experimental sewage treatment plant, of dubious reputation. The Philosophers' Gate guards the entrance, requiring one to sign into a guest book before entry.

During Brandon of Oxenfurt's youth, the academy was free and tolerant and nurtured progressive thinking, even if from time to time a professor or a student at the university was arrested for heresy, but otherwise the Redanian authorities kept a low profile. It is said that in Brandon of Oxenfurt's youth, the students were too poor to buy new shoes from a shoemaker. At that time, students' hobbies were darts and cockfighting.

The revolt of 1242 began at the university and quickly spread throughout the city when a group of students started organizing protests with the goal of establishing a democratic republic in Redania. The movement's activities disrupted the university's work and were therefore not approved by the dean and the professors. The protesters became bolder and more brutal every day, to the point that surgeons led by Joachim von Gratz executed anyone who rejected revolutionary ideas. Hubert Rejk, one of Joachim's professors, opposed him and was responsible for his imprisonment. After losing backup, the uprising was quickly brought to an end. Its leaders were thrown into the Tretogor dungeons and tortured for more than twenty years.
